def: OpenAI's coding agent, offered as an open-source (Apache-2.0) CLI, an IDE extension, a cloud agent, inside the ChatGPT apps and as an SDK, as of November 2026.
practice: It reads AGENTS.md and Agent Skills, runs locally under sandbox modes and approval policies, and reviews pull requests on request; not to be confused with Codex, the 2021 OpenAI code model behind the first GitHub Copilot.
